 SKIP ADVERTISEMENT Skims Offers Refunds for $150 Advent Calendar Full of Hair Ties and ‘Junk’
 Customers who bought the item from Skims, Kim Kardashian’s brand, were disappointed when they unwrapped what looked like the detritus in their handbags.
 Listen · 4:53 min Share full article 
 Kayla Ryan showed her disappointment with her advent calendar on TikTok, particularly several boxes filled with hair ties and bobby pins. Credit... Kayla Ryan By Alisha Haridasani Gupta 
 Nov. 9, 2026 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. Encuentra más de nuestra cobertura en los resultados de búsqueda. Add The New York Times as a preferred source on Google Agrega The New York Times como fuente preferida en Google › 
 “Are we serious right now?” Kayla Ryan, a content creator, asked in a video she posted on TikTok over the weekend, as she unboxed an advent calendar full of accessories from Skims, Kim Kardashian’s shapewear and loungewear brand.
 In the first box was a plaid teddy bear key ring. “That’s not bad,” she said.
 But with each new item in the $150, 12-day calendar, her outlook seemed to get worse. As she opened the next three boxes, Ryan unfurled tissue paper to reveal loose hair ties, scrunchies and pink bobby pins.
 “We might be on track for the worst advent calendar I’ve ever opened, and we’re only on No. 4,” she said to the camera, chuckling, in a video that has now been viewed tens of millions of times. In another box, Ryan found what looked like two “extra bra straps or headbands.”
 “They probably made these from the bra strap scraps,” she said, nodding to the brand’s core lingerie business.
 “I wish there was, like, a phone case or cute socks,” Ryan, who paid for the calendar, said in an interview. Instead, it contained items that, as she put it, she could have found at a dollar store.
 Others on TikTok and Instagram who had also purchased the calendar echoed her complaints. Across the platforms, people joked that it seemed as if the calendar were a vessel for the detritus that Kardashian found on her bedside table or buried at the bottom of her handbag. One user joked that the Skims team had perhaps swept forgotten hair ties and other bits and bobs out from under a sofa to throw into the calendar, which is currently out of stock, according to the brand’s website.
